name: app-set-datatype_tag-preprocessed
summary: Utility that copies a debiased, T1-aligned DWI (with bvals and bvecs) unchanged so the output carries the preprocessed datatype tag.
description: Copies the input files unchanged to the output (no image processing is done, the main script only copies files with jq and cp). Use it to relabel a dataset with the datatype tag shown on the output when the processing it reflects was done elsewhere. Do not use it to actually process data.

inputs.description: DWI image with bvals and bvecs; all three files must exist to be copied.

outputs.description: The same DWI, bvals and bvecs, copied unchanged and tagged preprocessed.
